spans.s:
रमट^1 m. pl. N. of a people.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: cf. pw = ramaWa (MW).

रमट˚क^1 m. pl. N. of a people.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: ? This not found in other dictionaries. However, since given as an alternate to 'rawa' which is misspelling of 'ramawa', this 'ka' must be added to 'ramawa', hence 'ramawaka'..

रमणीयजन्मन् a. whose birth is pleasant, born
under an auspicious star.
रमणीयडामरत्व n. delight and wonder.
रमणीयता f. ˚त्व n. loveliness, beauty.
1 रम॑ति f. a pleasant abode.
2 र॑मति a. liking to abide, not straying.
रमानाथ m. lord of Ramā i.e. Viṣṇu.
राम˚नाथ m. E. of Rāma, N. of sev. men.
रमा˚पति m. lord of Ramā i.e. Viṣṇu.
रमेश m. the same.
रमे˚श्वर m. the same.

रामेश्वर^1 m. a man's name.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: ? text has rAmeSrara. cf. MW, PW.
रम्ब् र॑म्बते hang down.
1 रम्भ् v. रभ्.
2 रम्भ् रम्भति रम्भ˚ते roar, bellow.

रम्भि॑न् a. carrying a stick;
 m. old man or door-keeper.

रम्भोरु f. ˚रु or ˚रू having beautiful
(plantain-like) thighs.
रम्य॑ a. enjoyable, charming, beautiful.
रा॑म्या f. night.
राम्या॑ f. night.
रम्यता f. ˚त्व n. charm, beauty.
रम्यदारुण a. beautiful and terrible.
रम्यान्तर a. offering pleasant intervals.
रामकृष्ण m. a man's name.
रामगिरि m. N. of a mountain.
रामचन्द्र m. Rāma-moon, E. of Rāma & N. of sev. men.
रामठ m. pl. N. of a people.
रामणीयक n. loveliness, beauty.
रामतापनी f. ˚तापनीय n. T. of an Upaniṣad.
रामतीर्थ n. N. of a place of pilgrimage.
रामदेव m. E. of Rāma, N. of sev. men.
रामह्रद m. Rāma's lake (a sacred bathing-place.)

रामायण f. ई relating to Rāma;
 n. N. of an epic poem.
